in_marathi.name: Bhavanee
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Creation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavanee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhavanee is a Hindu name for Goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and nature. It also refers to the creator of the universe.
